components.text: Here is a concise comparison of three daytime Bengaluru-to-Mysuru train services, using most consistent timetable entries across the supplied sources.
Shatabdi Express has a small timing discrepancy across sources: one source lists 1:4, while another lists 10:5.
Shatabdi Express also shows slight variation in duration, from about 2 h 15 m to 2 h 2 5 m.
Rajya Rani Express is consistently shown at 1:30 with a 2 h 30 m journey.
Wodeyar Express is consistently shown at 5:15 with a 2 h30 m journey.
If you want, I can also provide same comparison with arrival times and days of operation included.
